cause_quote: The original matcher used `text.toLowerCase().match(/[\p{L}\p{N}_-]+/gu)` and required `keywordTokens.every((token) => promptTokens.has(token))`, so an embedded CJK trigger could never equal the token for the entire unspaced sentence.
user_saw: A standing reminder failed to fire when its trigger appeared inside an unspaced Chinese, Japanese, or Korean prompt.
summary: The fix adds a bounded scan of eligible intents and matches CJK trigger terms within unspaced prompts.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff, which added standing intents and documented that trigger terms appearing in a turn could fire them. Its SQLite full-text prefilter and exact token check both missed terms embedded in an unspaced CJK sentence, the same failure reproduced in the fix's Gateway evidence.
